title: Madonna Teases ‘Confession on the Dance Floor 2’ With Instrumental Song Snippet, Provocative Speaker Straddling Pic
summary: The pop icon announced in November 2025 that she was prepping a sequel to her beloved 2005 electropop dance record.
contentText:
Madonna has firmly entered the Confessions on the Dance Floor 2 era. The pop icon provided the latest update on the sequel to her beloved 2005 Confessions on the Dance Floor electropop album on Tuesday morning (April 14) when she dropped an intriguing instrumental snippet and delightfully on-brand, provocative image to hype the project.

The post featured a high-gloss photo of a silver speaker positioned between the singer’s legs, with her fishnet-wrapped thighs protruding from the sides and her knee-high silver boots glinting like disco balls, high heels planted firmly on the ground on either side. The boots were a glittery update to the custom-made deep purple lace-up YSL go-go boots Madonna wore during the original Confessions era. The boot shot was accompanied by an untitled snippet of moody synth washes that ebbed and flowed like a celestial meditation soundtrack.

At press time there was no additional information about the album, which will mark Madonna’s return to her original label home , Warner Records, after nearly two decades away. She began getting fans amped up for her homecoming in November with the release of Confessions on a Dance Floor Twenty Years Edition , an expanded version of the 2005 album that featured such hits as “Hung Up,” “Sorry” and “Get Together.”

The digital deluxe edition expanded the original 12-track LP — featuring collaborations with producers Mirwais, Stuart Price and Bloodshy & Avant — with eight additional b-sides, remixes and promo-only tracks.

Prior to its release, Madonna teased, “Almost 2 decades later — And it feels like home with Warner Records! Back to music, Back to the Dance Floor, Back to where it all began! COADF – Pt. 2 2026.” The expanded  Confessions  LP came after a year of musical reflection from Madonna, which included the July release of her long-rumored  Veronica Electronica  album — a collection of eight rare and unreleased remixes of songs from her beloved 1998  Ray of Light  album — as well as the November revamp of her 1994  Bedtime Stories  album with the eight-track  Bedtime Stories — The Untold Chapter  EP.

Madonna was recently spotted Venice, where she was filming part of her two-episode arc for the upcoming season of Seth Rogen’s award-winning Apple TV series The Studio .
